content: नमस् {%ind.%} .²1 A bow, salutation, obeisance, adoration; (this word is, by itself, invariably used with <ab>dat.</ab>; तस्मै वदान्यगुरवे तरवे नमोऽस्तु <ls>Bv. 1. 94</ls>; नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यम् <ls>Ku. 2. 4</ls>; but with कृ, generally with <ab>acc.</ab>; मुनित्रयं नमस्कृत्य <ls>Sk.</ls>; but sometimes with <ab>dat.</ab> also; नमस्कुर्मो नृसिंहाय {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%} The word has the sense of a noun, but is treated as an indeclinable.) .²2 <ab>Ved.</ab> Food. .²3 A thunderbolt. .²4 A gift, present. .²5 A sacrifice.
